title: The Bus to the Stadium Was Already a Party 🚌⚽
script: Hours before kickoff, the bus turns into a party on wheels. Songs, chants, scarves out the windows. You board as strangers. You step off as family. Everyone on that bus knows one thing: today, we are champions in waiting. The World Cup doesn't start when the whistle blows. It starts the moment you commit to going.
prompt_for_hailuo: Young woman with long dark hair, wearing vibrant team jersey, standing on a packed fan bus heading to the World Cup stadium [Static shot, bus interior packed with cheering fans, jerseys and scarves everywhere]. She leads a chant, clapping and singing with other fans around her [Tracking shot following her as she leads the crowd in celebration]. Everyone on the bus erupts singing and dancing, drums banging, scarves waving [Push in on her face, singing loudly, pure happiness and anticipation]. Second clip: bus arrives — she steps off bursting with energy, running toward the stadium entrance with other fans [Tracking shot following her running toward the grand stadium facade]. Stadium towers above, streams of fans converging, energy crackling in the air [Pull out to reveal massive World Cup stadium at sunset, fan rivers flowing in]. World Cup fan bus and stadium exterior, warm golden hour light, electric pre-game energy, 9:16 portrait.
